title: Quantum Tumtum
description: Quantum Tumtum is a Qiskit Aer GPU simulation project with Bell-state and 27-qubit QAOA Max-Cut examples, executable Colab notebooks, and a project website. Its VRAM-capped statevector benchmark includes runs on a 4 GiB RTX 3050 (27 qubits) and a GPU reporting 15,360 MiB VRAM (28 qubits, 40% cap, 2,048 MiB reserve, 1.5x overhead). The latter run stopped before 29 qubits; the GPU model was not reported. Distributed under GNU GPL version 3.
